title: coap_keys_cbor.c ISO-timestamp snprintf trips -Werror=format-truncation on 32-bit targets
description: Found while verifying bd 6mij.2.2. coap_keys_cbor.c:156 snprintf(buf, buf_len, "%04u-%02u-%02uT%02u:%02u:%02uZ", ...) into a 21-byte buffer: GCC 12 under the module hardening set (-Wformat-truncation=2, -Werror) errors on i386/qemu_x86 ('Z directive output may be truncated writing 1 byte into a region of size between 0 and 2'), because uint32 fields can exceed 4 digits. 64-bit native_sim CI does not see it, so any 32-bit target build of LICHEN_COAP_KEYS is broken. Fix: size the buffer for the worst case (>= 23 bytes) or clamp the fields before formatting. Local validation: west build -b qemu_x86 tests/coap_keys (ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen module); build previously required an uncommitted -Wno-error=format-truncation override.
